en: The war's over, and it's time to celebrate<FG> Everything else can wait till later<FG>
Arey, look<MV>there's a teleportal<FG> That must be the way to the other world<FG>
No doubt about it<FG> An' if we're lucky, the back door to Fractos's place'll be just beyond<FG>
Ngh... I fear the end is nigh... Help me drive these fiends away, I beg you<FG>
Haaah... Haaah... I could not have defeated those fiends alone. You have my heartfelt thanks<FG>
Waaaaaagh<FG> There's monsters everywhere<FG> Please, you have to help me<FG>
I, I'm saved<FG> Thank you, from the bottom of my heart<FG>
Wait a minute<FG> We're right back where we came from...aren't we<FH>
It does look that way... Strange... The teleportal definitely seemed to work...
What's the matter, Cesar<FH> You look even more miserable than usual.
Hm. Unlike you, I have grown-up problems to attend to.
I will be representing Dunisia at the ceremony tomorrow...not as a prince, but as a king...
Of course<FG> What with everything that's been going on, I'd completely forgotten<MV>you're the new King of Dunisia<FG>
Yes. My duty now is to protect my kingdom and its people, just as my father did... Just as the late King of Harba did...
But the man who murdered my father and drove the world to war still walks free. I long to find him...and see that he suffers.
I see... So you can't decide whether to go back to Dunisia to rule after the ceremony tomorrow, or to keep looking for the seer<FH>
Not only that... Returning to Dunisia would<MV> It would mean leaving everyone behind. You included.
Well, you didn't seem that upset when we went our separate ways four years ago<FG>
Hm. I may not have seemed it, but I do have a heart, you know... In any case, I will continue to think this over...
What does this mean<FH> Is it some kind of trick<FH>
We can't be sure of anything yet. Let's go outside and see if anything looks different.
This is still the Grand Dunes...right<FH> But it wasn't night when we went in... Hmm...
We've got company.
It doesn't look aggressive. Let's try talking to it...
It'll take some time to organise Prince Cesar's hearing. I know you're worried about your friend, but could you wait a little while longer<FH>
You are the otherworldly warriors who seek to take Fractos to task, correct<FH>
<F4><I0>00 receives an ogre shield<FG>
You must defeat Fractos, and ensure that your world does not suffer the same fate as did ours<FG> Fight valiantly, brave warriors<FG>
This world's light is extinguished... Eternal night reigns... Behold the devastation that surrounds you, otherworlders...
And you are<FH> Ah, of course. The ones who would do battle with Fractos...
<F4><I0>00 receives a chunk of orichalcum<FG>
There is nothing more terrifying than Fractos and his wickedness... But you cannot give in... You must not<FG>
I heard that Unos's palace fell from the sky in the north-western part of the wilds. Be careful, won't you<FH>
You are the ones who are off to fight Fractos, correct<FH> One can't help but remember Unos doing the same... So very brave...
Ooh<FG> You're the ones who came from the other world to fight Fractos, right<FH>
<F4><I0>00 receives a bondstone<FG>
I meant to tell you... His Radiance has asked me to go in search of the black-robed seer when the celebrations are over.
Then we're coming with you<FG> I'm not missing out on the chance to unmask the villain who murdered Cesar's father<FG>
Ha<FG> And what about your studies, hm<FH> Or have you forgotten that you're both still knights-in-training<FH>
Ugh, please not you as well. Look, we're going to be travelling together, so just plain ‘Desdemona’ will be fine, okay<FH>
And what about you two<FH> I know you're cousins, and that you're both from Dunisia originally, but...what do I call you<FH>
I'm <F4><S3>, and this is <F4><S2><FG> We're both trainee knights at the Academy in Dunisia.
Well, sort of<MV>I've spent the last year studying in Harba. Needed to get away from Miss Smarty-Pants here. Heh<FG>
<F4><S2><FG> Don't call me that in front of Lady Des<MV> I mean, Desdemona<FG>
Ha ha<FG> I can see I'm going to have some fun with you two<FG> Come on then<MV>shall we get going<FH>
What's this strange crystal<FH> I haven't seen one of these before...
It's called a Zoomstone. You can use Zoom to travel to them. They've been around since...well, forever.
Oh, I see. Zoom's that spell that lets you travel to far-off places in the blink of an eye, isn't it<FH> You need a Zoomethyst to cast it, right<FH>
Then we need to get one<FG> That sounds like my kind of spell<FG>
I hate to break it to you, but Zoomethysts don't exactly grow on trees. I've only ever heard of kings and queens having them.
Bah, what a let-down. And there I was thinking we'd be able to zip over to Accordia just like that...
Ha ha. Well, don't give up just yet. You never know what you might find.
Tell you what<MV>why not attune yourself to this Zoomstone just on the off-chance you end up learning the spell one day<FH>
But as you are here, allow me to invoke the powers of the Arbiter of All Vocations, and provide you with some insight... Hmm... Yes...
I see that you walk the path of the warrior... And that you are destined to walk it a little longer yet...
Warriors are masters of battle, skilled in the use of the sword, twin swords, axe and shield. A noble profession indeed.
Maribel and Ruff join the party<FG>
Well, Prince Cesar, it looks like you're coming to Accordia with us. We'll need you to explain yourself to the High King.
The King of Harba has already set out. Anything you want to say to him, you can say when we get there.
Hm. I will play along with your little charade. But only to see justice done. Do not think for one second that you have bested me.
Ha<FG> Bested you<FG><FH> We beat you black and blue<FG> I see that princes are every bit as stubborn and stupid in your world as in mine<FG>
Cesar... (sigh)
I've ordered some men to take the Prince back to Accordia. We should head there too.
Alright... (sigh) What happened to you, Cesar<FH>
Lady Desdemona<FG>
The Prince's hearing is to be held in the throne room<FG> The necessary preparations are being made as we speak<FG>
Thank you.
Desdemona<FG> You have to let us be there<FG> We're going mad worrying about what's been going on with Cesar<FG>
Outsiders aren't usually allowed in to proceedings like these without the High King's permission.
But you two did play a crucial role in all of this... Alright, I'll talk to His Radiance and see what I can do.
Thanks, Desdemona<FG>
In the meantime, why don't you take a look around town<FH> It looks like a few new places have opened up shop since we were last here.
So if you're friends with Torneko...does that mean you're from his world as well<FH> How did you end up here<FH>
Well... My sister went out and didn't come back, so I went where the cards told me she would be, and...before I knew it, I was here.

NOT USED
I wouldn't get your hopes up<MV>the monsters of the forest are even worse than those of the desert. Be on your guard.
Right, not even Morph<FG> Er... What's that again<FH>
Seriously<FG><FH> Have you forgotten everything they ever taught us<FG><FH> It's a spell that lets you look like anything you want<FG>
<F4><I0>00 receives a pepstone<FG>
Blimey<FG> Did you feel that<FG><FH> It sent a jolt right through me<FG> And now I feel...fired up<FG>
Me too<FG> What is this thing<FH>
It is called a pepstone. It will focus the fire within you, and drive your tension to ever-greater heights.
In doing so, it will open the path to newer and greater abilities. May it aid you on the journey ahead.
Wow<FG> Thanks, Your Majesty<FG>
Indeed. Tsarevna has been greatly concerned for all your safeties<FG>
But how did you find out what was happening<FH> And how did you get here<FH>
A most peculiar voice informed me in a dream<FG> It says my friends are embroiled in war, and that I must hasten to assist them<FG>
Tsarevna flew promptly from castle, and I gave spirited chase. Before realising, we found ourselves in this present location.
And speaking of which, what is this place, please<FH> I am mortified to confess that we have lost our bearings entirely...
These surroundings appear so unfamiliar, I am almost of the mind that we have journeyed to an altogether other world...
So I know she's here somewhere, but I haven't got the foggiest how to find her...
Not to worry<FG> The Queen will know something one way or the other, I'm sure<FG>
You make it sound as if Her Majesty will be in the mood to talk. I somehow doubt she will be happy to see us...
Then I'm glad I will not be seeing her alone. And that our fates are intertwined...for now.
I hope I won't be too much of a burden.
Meena joins the party<FG>
Well, what are we waitin' for, eh<FH>\nLet's go see this queen o' yours<FG>
Sorry, but I won't be coming with you. I've got a little...business to attend to.
What<FG><FH> Where are you going<FH>
If something's going on in Ingenia, it's unlikely the Queen will know the whole picture. I need to ask some questions around town.
It's better if I go alone<MV>it'll make it easier to keep a low profile. Don't worry, I'll be back soon enough.
Well, alright, but...be careful, won't you<FH>
You too. I'll catch up with you later<FG>
So...who exactly was this seer in black<FH> And how did he know what was going to happen<FH>
Very sorry, but unless you have a permit from the High King, I must ask that you turn back.
The lands that lie beyond this gate are extremely perilous<FG> None may enter without the High King's permission<FG>
Turn back, traveller<FG> Unless you have His Radiance's leave, the lands that lie beyond this gate are strictly off limits<FG>
If you have reason to go beyond this gate, you'll need to ask His Radiance for permission.
Oi, where do you think you're going<FH> In case you've forgotten, we've got an audience with the High King<FG>
It's going to take a little longer to arrange, but you need to stay close. Why don't you carry on looking around town<FH>
Let's get going, shall we<FH> The throne room is at the top of the Pinnacle of Peace.
Hello, you lot<FG> Long time no see, eh<FH> I'm still keeping myself busy travelling around the Seven Realms selling my wares.
Speaking of which<MV>I've just come from Dunisia, and I heard a rumour that might be of interest to adventurers like you.
Apparently, there's an ancient treasure hidden somewhere inside the pyramids. A golden weapon that shines like the sun...
It might just be a rumour, but if it really does exist, I'd love to get a look at it. Satisfy my professional curiosity, so to speak...
Which reminds me<MV>I'd better be getting back on the road. I mustn't keep my customers waiting<FG> Take care of yourselves, alright<FH>
Ah, there you are. The hearing is about to begin.
You know where the throne room is already. Come on, we should get over to the Pinnacle of Peace as soon as possible.
Honestly, he's such a stubborn old goat<FG> If he was hungry, he only had to say so. Don't you think he's being ridiculous<FH>
Why doesn't anyone believe me<FG><FH> I didn't eat anyone's blessed lunch<FG>
A float-o-copier just went flying by. It looked harmless enough, though, so I let it be. Nothing to report<FG> All's peaceful in Harba<FG>
But it will take them a little while to get ready for us. Why not take a look around town while we're waiting<FH>
It looks like a few more shops and stalls have opened for business. It'll be a while before the hearing begins<MV>why not do a little shopping<FH>
Ah, perfect timing. They're ready for us over at the Pinnacle.
Shall we get moving<FH> The Queen's already been waiting a while.
‘If you are reading this, you have proved yourself a true master of the shadows. I hereby admit you to the league of thieves.’
<F4><I0>01 found the secret message<FG>
‘P.S. Do not allow the guards to spot you on your way out. A professional pilferer always leaves the scene unseen.’
Wait, what am I talking about<FG><FH> Healix<MV>you'll have to do it<FG>
Everyone in the city will be there, so if you want to do any shopping or visit the priestess or anything, now's the time.
I'll be waiting here. That client list means the world to me<MV>bring it back in one piece, I'm begging you<FG>
My business is saved, and it's all thanks to you<FG> Thank you so much<FG>
There's a war on, in case you haven't heard, so don't expect safe passage through Outer Dunisia<MV>you won't get it.
Oi, cloth-ears<FG> Didn't I tell you<FH> You need a writ of passage<FG> Get out of here before I have to try and use this rusty old spear<FG>
If you've any unfinished business, you'd better get it out of the way.
So, are you ready for the party<FH>
Oi<FG> Wot are you scamperin' 'round back 'ere for<FG><FH> If you wanna buy somefink, 'ead back round the front<FG>
...Hm<FH> What's that, <E0>00boy<E3>00girl<E4>01<FH> Speak up<FG> I can't hear a word you're saying.
Mini medals are the bee's knees, lemme tell ya<FG> You find any, you bring 'em to me. I'll make you an offer you can't refuse<FG>
Have you spoken with the Clerk of Works yet<FH> She's my sister, you know<FG> But people say there's no resemblance at all...
I don't know what you think you're doing back there. If you want to use the cauldron, come round in front of me and ask nicely<FG>
Hmm... If we could get this tree to fall over, we might be able to use it as a bridge to get over to that island...
Accordia's such a lovely city. I can see why so many people choose to stay for longer than they planned<FG>
If you have business with us, my child, please conduct it from the front of the counter.
My sister is starting a shop out in the main square. I don't think it's open yet, but please pay her a visit once she's ready<FG>
I'm sorry, <E0>00sir<E3>00ma'am<E4>01, but I am afraid I must ask you to make any enquiries from the other side of the counter.
I'm sorry, we're not quite ready for business yet. You'll have to come back later.
I patrol these streets each and every day. 'Tis the duty of a soldier of Accordia to ensure that the city is safe.
Mention Accordia, and the first thing people think of is the Pinnacle of Peace. It's a symbol of power visible from anywhere in the land.
I just love the view from here. I could spend all day gazing out over the city...
I'm going to train every single day so I can be a super-powerful warrior like Lady Desdemona when I'm older<FG>
When I grow up, I want to be just like Lady Desdemona<FG>
<F4><I0>00 acquires the Trinity Stone<FG>
The guardians' true identity is revealed<FG>
...Hm<FH> Hmmm<FG><FH> Can it really be true<FH> You have gained complete mastery of your weapon<FG> Well done, my young disciple<FG>
A new quest is now available<FG>
A writ of passage is required in order to pass<FG> No exceptions<FG>
He's right<FG> We need to get back to Accordia<FG> This is an emergency<FG>
<F4><I0>41 tries to read the sign...\nBut <EK>00he<EL>00she<EM>00's standing on the wrong side of it, and can't see what it says<FG>
‘You are now entering the Grand Dunes<FG> Don't set out without stocking up on supplies<FG>\n<MV> The Accordian Entrepreneurial Association’
‘Head through the tunnel to reach Dunisia. Aim for the giant skull.’
‘Poisonous swamp<FG> Danger<FG> Keep out<FG>’
‘South-West<FI> Dunisia\nEast<FI> Oasis\nNorth<FI> Accordia’

The bridge is out<FG> The party can't go any further<FG>
Ya want that thing knockin' down, huh<FH> Well, I ain't no pushover, but if it's a pusher-overer you're after, I'm your guy<FG> Get a loada this<FG>
Alright, here I come<FG> Time to thunk that trunk<FG> HYAAARRRGH<FG>
Whoever he was, he made quite an impression on the people of Ingenia. Everyone was talking about him prophesying doom left and right.
That's strange... What's a barrier doing all the way out here<FH>
Monsters make these, don't they<FH> And you have to beat the monster that made it to make it go away, right<FH>
Someone's been paying attention in class. Still, I don't see any likely culprits around<MV>let's leave it for now and head to Accordia.
I did not see his face. The hood of his cloak hid it completely.
And though I asked that he be brought before me again when his prophecies began to come true...he was nowhere to be found.
I can tell you little more. Come, there is no time for idle chatter. We must go to Accordia and speak with His Radiance.
I will put my story before him. You will tell him yours. And perhaps some truth can be dragged out of this sorry little affair...
Carver's Knuckle Sandwich sends the tree crashing to the ground<FG>
Proceed to the throne room<FH>

Wow<FG> You knocked it down with a single punch<FG> Incredible<FG>
The doors are shut fast.
I thought the High King would be, er, a bit...taller... But I guess ‘Low King’ doesn't have quite the same ring to it...
What he lacks in stature he more than makes up for in wisdom. He's descended from a great sage who advised the kings of old, you know.
His line have been responsible for keeping the peace of the world ever since it was split into seven after the war a thousand years ago.
And it's not just his lineage that's impressive. He's also a renowned scholar. He knows more about our world than anyone alive.
Anyway, that's enough about the High King for now. Let's head back to town<MV>Torneko will be wondering where we've got to.
Well now... So ye're off to this Dunisia place on the High King's say-so, eh<FH>
NOT USED
And you have accumulated some skill points, I see. You will be blessed with these ability-enhancing gifts whenever your level rises.
Ack<FG> Errr... Ahem, ahem<FG>
We have succeeded in driving back the initial onslaught...but I fear that the Beastlanders will not be so easily defeated.
Sire<FG> A horde of monsters has amassed at the mouth of the valley leading to the main Al-Khazami force<FG>
Mawkeepers have also been sighted to the east and the west<FG>
I have to make the King of Harba proud... I have to get big and strong so I can goo my bit... (slurp)
Goowee<FG> I can feel new magic oozing through my veins<FG>
Hmm... They intend to attack on three fronts at once<FH> Then we must strike the first blow before they can succeed<FG>
Dunisia<FG> Ingenia<FG> March to the east and west and defeat the mawkeepers<FG>
Nightmaws appear<FG>
The door slams shut<FG>
I cannot help but be suspicious... The Al-Khazami headquarters lie just ahead, and yet...
Hmm... Just as I feared...
Meow<FG>
Forward, my slimy steed<FG>
(slurp)
What's going on<FH> I just saw a float-o-copier rush past. You're not playing hide-and-seek, are you<FH> Can I play<FH>
I'm making an honest living here as a carpenter<MV>honest<FG> I've been doing repairs on the cathedral<FG>
Smashing wood, all day long, smashing wood while I sing this song<FG> ...Hm<FH> The weird guard<FH> He ran off. Went for a nap or something...
Zzz... Forward, my...slimy steed... Zzz...
Zzz... Zzz...
Hello, and welcome to Harba<FG>
Squee<FG> I'm in the middle of my morning walk, and you're a teeny bit in the way<FG> Can you move, pleeease<FH>
‘Follow the road north to reach Accordia.’
‘Follow the road east to reach Accordia.’
‘Follow the road straight on to reach Accordia.’
That sounds like a wonderful plan, Your Majesty. But before you go<MV>there's the little matter of my reward...
Did you see that<FH> It lit up<FG> Does this mean the trials have started<FH> It, err...doesn't look like much has changed...
Do not try my patience, girl. You have been reunited with your sister. That is more than you deserve.
Well, it was worth a try<FG> I suppose I'd better come along with you people then, hm<FH>
I haven't got the foggiest what's going on, but if Meena's been hanging around with you, you can't be all bad<FG>
Gragwort told us that the Trinity Stone is to be found somewhere within the pyramids of Dunisia.
The pyramids will not readily give up their secrets to those unfamiliar with their intricacies. Luckily, I know them well.

NOT USED
Heh heh<FG> I envy you young whippersnappers<FG> When I was your age, I was off on adventures of my own, you know<FG>
I can't shake the feeling that somebody's watching me. I'm sure it's just my imagination...
Have you ever seen snow<FH> Apparently there's lots of it beyond this gate, but I've never gone through to the other side...
Only grown-ups are allowed through the city gates. I hope I get big soon so I can see what's outside the city<FG>
Wh-What<FG><FH> Don't sneak up on me like that<FG> Are you trying to give me a heart attack<FH>
Anuvver tourist come for a gander at the Pinnacle o' Peace, eh<FH> Can't say I blame ya<FG> Get a good eyeful before you 'ead 'ome<FG>
Inns, places to change yer vocation, places to 'ave a nice drink... You name it, Accordia's got it<FG>
Ahhh, breathe in that sweet, sweet air<FG> And the weather's perfect too<MV>makes you wish we had time to lie down and soak up some sun<FG>
Soak up some bonks on the head, more like<FG> The monsters around these parts are a mischievous bunch.
And besides, knights-in-training aren't supposed to spend their days lazing around in sunny meadows. Come on, let's get moving<FG>
They can be used to learn new skills, or to improve existing ones. Spend them wisely, child. Their value is incalculable.
(sigh) I never thought that the next time we saw Cesar would be on the opposite side of a battlefield, did you<FH>
Halt<FG> The road ahead is dangerous and closed to travellers.
The old road goes through the graveyard over yonder. Mind yourselves<MV>it's more than a little dangerous<FG>
Do you know, I had almost forgotten<FG> I can't imagine going back to the Academy after all that's happened...
Well, you must. It will be a shame to go our separate ways, but we all have our duties. Besides, I have a feeling the seer might be...
No, it's nothing. We've got a party to go to<FG> Let's make the most of our last evening together<FG>
The Dreadbolt is the scariest thing ever<FG> You've got to stop Fractos before he can fire it again<FG>
The ruins are in the wilds, far to the north of here. May you find what you seek there...
You're the ones who are going to give Fractos what for, aren't you<FH> Want to hear a secret<FH>
Ooh, ooh<FG> You're going to go and beat up Fractos, right<FH> Here, take this<FG>
